away.summary: The Avalanche (9-5-1) are on a back-to-back after defeating the Chicago Blackhawks 5-2 on Monday. They did not hold a morning skate, and Mackenzie Blackwood is projected to start after making 21 saves in that game, though Scott Wedgewood may also start. Zachary L'Heureux and Josh Manson remain injured.

home.summary: The Blue Jackets (5-7-0) host the Avalanche wearing their Hometown Remix uniforms. Cam Talbot is projected to start in goal. Danton Heinen is scratched and replaced by Dmitri Voronkov on the second line, while Charlie Coyle moves to the third line and Sean Monahan to the fourth. The third defensive pairing remains a game-time decision between Emil Andrae and Erik Gudbranson.
